verdict.rationale: Zapier is a workflow automation platform, so inspecting run history and replaying failed runs is a fair question. The evidence pack documents only AI-generated troubleshooting instructions and general error-help articles. Neither shows viewing past execution logs or re-running a failed execution from the failing step, so they are adjacent at best.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can inspect past execution logs and re-run a failed execution, resuming from the failing step
